test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 22 Oct 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
**Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.**

PROMPT
solution: The correct answer is '**Sluggish**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The most appropriate **antonym** of the given word '**Prompt**' is '**Sluggish**'. • **Prompt**: immediate; done without delay. [अत्‍यावश्‍यक; बिना बिलंब किया (कार्य)] • *Example: We need a **prompt** decision on this matter.* • **Sluggish**: moving or working more slowly than normal in a way that seems lazy. (सुस्‍ती भरी धीमी गति से चलने या काम करने वाला; ढीला-ढाला) • *Example: She felt **sluggish** in comparison.* **Correct Answer:__** *Sluggish.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** • Let's look at the meaning of other words: • **Alert**: watching, listening, etc. for something with all your attention. सतर्क, चौकन्‍ना, चौकस • **Immediate**: happening or done without delay. तुरंत होने या किया जाने वाला, तत्‍काल संपन्‍न; अविलंब • **Speedy**: fast; quick. तेज़, द्रुतगामी; शीघ्र, तत्‍काल 36:Tb73, The erroneously spelt word is '**Grownd**'.
